⏰ Deliveries by TDD — overdue & upcoming

Every open booking with its TDD, in one list. Days column is negative when a delivery is past due (−2 = two days late) and positive when it's still ahead. Text TDDs are handled by priority: ASAP sorts with the most urgent (top when Old→New), HOLD always sits at the very bottom. Admin sees the whole team; a sales login sees only their own.
📄 Pending Bookings — Full List (customer name, model, TDD/expected delivery)

🪔 Festive Booking Shield — Navratri to Diwali

Every pending booking is matched to one specific bike in KN stock — first booked, first served; oldest bike first. Those bikes are held: do not sell them to a walk-in. Anything left over is free to sell. Bookings with no bike need an order now, before the Navratri rush empties the floor.

🚦 Sell or Hold — by model & colour

🏷️ Hold List — tag these bikes for the customer

📦 Order Plan — before Diwali (Admin)

🔎 Book vs Stock — Select a Model

Pick a model to see the stock of every colour (free or not) and whose booking is on it. Bookings are in FIFO order (first to book is first in line) — when a bike arrives, the customer at the top gets it. Every sales person's bookings are visible to everyone; customer mobiles stay hidden.

🔎 Model Finder — Bookings vs Stock by Colour (summary)

Per colour: how many are pending vs how many are Open in KN stock right now. Shortfall = booked, but no stock.

🏭 Booking vs Stock — Model-wise Summary

Har model + colour ka: total booking, KN stock me kitna, transit me kitna, aur short (bike kam) ya extra (bike zyada). Short = Booking − (Stock + Transit). Neeche table dekho, ya Export CSV se Excel me nikalo.
